title: Size of the tableau circuit
statement: For every finite-state Turing machine $M$ with Boolean input and output, and all natural numbers $n$ and $T$, the tableau circuit with input width $n$ and time parameter $T$ has size $n+2+(T+1)W$, where $W$ is the tableau width determined by $M$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
